label: Pessimistic locking (getAndLock)
type: the SDK's opt-in exclusive-lock alternative to the default sdk:cas-optimistic-locking - getAndLock() locks a document server-side for a bounded duration, blocking other writers until unlock or timeout, rather than merely detecting a conflicting write after the fact
note: Cross-product recurrence: java-sdk/howtos/concurrent-document-mutations.json, java-sdk/concept-docs/data-durability-acid-transactions.json, python-sdk/concept-docs/data-durability-acid-transactions.json - both SDKs document it as the named alternative to CAS.
